How do I use it properly the very first time?

Here's how to get started with your new Carry-On:



Set the dials to 0-0-0, which is the default combination for all new Away suitcases.


Slide the latch toward the number dials to release the zipper pulls from the lock.


If the zipper pulls feel stuck, gently press them inward toward the lock while sliding the latch, since they can be seated tightly from packaging.


Check for any cardboard inserts near the lock area and gently remove them before trying again.


Once the zipper pulls are free, unzip and open it up!



After that, you can set your own combination by following our lock setup guide.
